metadata.notes: Fees = HyperCore trading fees (perp+spot+HIP-3, node_fills, gross) + HyperEVM gas + builder fees + spot deploy auction proceeds + HIP-3 perp deploy auction proceeds + priority fees. Reconstructed from node_fills (S3 archive) from fees_start_date; earlier dates have fees=0. Spot fees priced via spot snapshots from spot_price_start_date; earlier spot fees use earliest-available price as proxy. Builder fees (builder_metrics) start 2025-10-23. HIP-3 fees are split: fees_hip3 holds the protocol (Assistance Fund-bound) portion, fees_hip3_deployer the DEX-deployer portion (accrues to a third party, like builder fees). The split uses each dex's deployerShare (from deployerFeeScale in hyperliquid_snapshots, reconstructed per day as it can change over time). Priority fees (order + gossip) from priority_fee_hourly_summary. fees_auction_perp = HIP-3 perp listing auction proceeds (gasUsed converted to USDC via daily HYPE price, from hl_auctions_perp/data.csv). Revenue/holders_revenue = HyperCore buybacks + HyperEVM burn + auction burn (builder fees and priority fees are excluded from revenue — they accrue to builders/validators; auction proceeds count in both fees and revenue as they are burned to holders). Earnings = revenue (token incentives are $0).
